cards.english_title: Five Sudanese Power Stations Hit, Causing Widespread Outages

cards.english_desc: RSF drones struck five Sudanese power stations on October 26, 2026. The attacks cut electricity across Al-Jazira, Gedaref, and White Nile states. Residents said outages threatened insulin, food stocks, irrigation, and shops. The United Nations says power attacks threaten health services for millions.

cards.takeaway_english: In Sudan's war, attacking electricity can quickly become a health and food crisis.

cards.takeaway_english: Lula returns with a mandate, but governing will require cooperation beyond his supporters.

why_it_matters.english: Brazil's result may influence politics across Latin America.
